svg.aria-label: TomatoBot v2 on a bench beside a planter of three staked tomato plants. The robot is a black plywood deck on four wheels with gear motors, carrying a Raspberry Pi, a motor driver, two cells, a power bank, a webcam that looks at the row and a cup. A six-servo arm stands at the back of the deck. Ripe tomatoes are picked and dropped in the cup; unripe ones are left on the vine.
